title: LLM egress proxy route contract, v1
description: The set of upstream hosts a multi-tenant LLM egress proxy deployment serves, and how each is authenticated. Produced from the proxy's own launcher; a consumer reads this artifact and never restates it. Carries no credential, no key-environment name, no listen port, and no host of ours.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking shape change. Consumers must refuse a version they do not understand rather than reading it partially.

produced_by.description: Repo-relative path of the generator that derives this file. Its --check mode fails the producer's CI when the launchers and this file diverge.

produced_from.description: Table name to the repo-relative launcher it was derived from, in the private producer repo.

tables.description: One entry per proxy DEPLOYMENT. Deployments are never unioned: a host served by one is not thereby served by another.

upstream_host.description: Third-party provider endpoint the proxy will forward to when a request carries this value in X-Upstream-Host. A host absent here is refused with `unknown upstream host`.

auth_mode.description: keyed: the proxy substitutes a credential it holds. passthrough: the client's own credential is forwarded unchanged.

path_prefix.description: The upstream's API path root, prepended by the proxy. null when the upstream is addressed at its bare root.
